name: StarBorder-TS-TW
title: Star Border
description: Two dark rounded panels on black, one teal and one pink, with a soft coloured glow that slides along their top and bottom edges in a loop.
use: A call-to-action or small promo card needs to glow without a heavy animation.
avoid: It hardcodes a near-black face and white text, so it cannot sit on a light theme.
a11y: The component renders a real button by default, but there is no focus styling and the looping glow ignores reduced-motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Two pill-shaped dark panels with near-black gradient faces, a short button label on one and a bold heading with grey paragraph on the other. A soft tinted bloom hugs part of each edge, teal on the small one and pink on the wide one.
behaves: A blurred coloured spot travels back and forth along the top and bottom borders, fading as it goes, so each panel seems to have a spark circling it. The content itself never moves.
customise: Colour, animation duration and border thickness are props, plus the rendered element via as and any native props. The face gradient and text colours are fixed.
weight: light: Two blurred gradient divs animated by CSS keyframes; nothing runs in JavaScript.
